main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.l: Crisis nomen quotupliciter ab Hippocrate accipiatur Br. | 1.20
an à Crisi vniuscuiusque morbi victus ratio sumenda sit Br. | 1.18
Febri in qua exteriora frigent & interiora calent, & econtra, accommodus victus Br. | 3.25
Febri à pituita dulci & salsa quis victus conueniat Br. | 3.13

page.notes: Printed "Faciei maculatarum" appears as "Faciei macularum" in the scan; left as read with doubt. Some numbers are old-style (e.g. 351, 203, 243) and read with some uncertainty. Lower-right "Fluoris" is the catchword.
